{{Quote|Soldiers: escort your Queen to the Palace.|The Queen of the Red in [[Quesoth Soldier Speak]]|translated=1|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The '''Palace''' was a building within the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]]. The [[City/Legends|City's]] ruler, the [[Queen of the Red]], resided within the residential wing of the [[Palace]], and<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> left the wing for the [[Dwelling of Guests]] building&mdash;located within the citadel&mdash;followed by [[Gender/Legends|her]] entourage. Two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after her visit to the Dwelling, four thousand [[Quesoth Soldier]]s rushed to the palace after one of the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen's]] [[Speaker/Legends|loudspeakers]] were [[Thief/Legends|commandeered]] by the [[Empire of the Hand]], and subsequently [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] the Soldiers to protect [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] with a recording of the Queen ordering that to her forces. In turn, Esva [[Death/Legends|killed]] the monarch fearing [[Treason/Legends|treason]] while he and his [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|warriors]], the Chosen, perished shortly after.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Palace appeared in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published within the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of his [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
